cases.sentence: ___ отвечал «Это пророк Иисус из Назарета, что в Галилее».
cases.translation: The crowd answered, 'This is the prophet Jesus from Nazareth in Galilee.'
cases.explain: Народ is the subject of the verb отвечал, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Скажите дочери ___, вот идет к тебе царь твой, кроткий, верхом на ослице и осленке.
cases.translation: Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your king comes to you, gentle, riding on a donkey and a colt.
cases.explain: The noun дочь (daughter) takes a genitive complement — the daughter OF Zion.

cases.sentence: Скажите ___ Сиона, вот идет к тебе царь твой, кроткий, верхом на ослице и осленке.
cases.translation: Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your king comes to you, gentle, riding on a donkey and a colt.
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to tell/say) requires its addressee in the dative case — tell TO the daughter.

cases.sentence: Иисус вошел в ___ и выгнал оттуда всех продающих и покупающих.
cases.translation: Jesus entered the temple and drove out all those who were selling and buying there.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative; for the inanimate masculine храм the accusative equals the nominative.

cases.sentence: Дом мой будет назван ___ молитвы, а вы превратили его в разбойничье логово.
cases.translation: My house will be called a house of prayer, but you have turned it into a den of robbers.
cases.explain: The passive verb назван (will be called) requires its predicate noun in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Они пришли в селение Вифагия, что расположено на Масличной ___.
cases.translation: They came to the village of Bethphage, which is located on the Mount of Olives.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location (on the mount) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Ученики пошли и сделали все так, как велел им Иисус.
reading.question: How did the disciples respond to Jesus' instructions about the donkey?
options: They did exactly as Jesus commanded them
They asked the villagers for money instead
They brought a horse instead of a donkey
reading.correct: They did exactly as Jesus commanded them
reading.explain: The text says 'Ученики пошли и сделали все так, как велел им Иисус' (the disciples went and did just as Jesus had commanded them).

reading.ru: Толпы людей, что шли впереди и позади него, громко кричали «Ассанна сыну Давида! Благословен тот, кто приходит во имя Господа! Ассанна в вышине небес!»
reading.question: What did the crowds shout as Jesus entered Jerusalem?
options: Hosanna to the son of David
reading.correct: Hosanna to the son of David
reading.explain: The crowds cried out 'Ассанна сыну Давида! Благословен тот, кто приходит во имя Господа!' (Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!).

reading.ru: И когда Иисус вошел в Иерусалим, весь город пришел в волнение, и все спрашивали «Кто это?»
reading.question: How did the city of Jerusalem react to Jesus' entrance?
options: The whole city was stirred up, asking who he was
The city celebrated with a feast
reading.correct: The whole city was stirred up, asking who he was
reading.explain: The text says 'весь город пришел в волнение, и все спрашивали «Кто это?»' (the whole city was stirred up, and everyone asked 'Who is this?').

reading.ru: Иисус вошел в храм и выгнал оттуда всех продающих и покупающих.
reading.question: What did Jesus do upon entering the temple?
options: He drove out all those buying and selling there
He began teaching the Ten Commandments
reading.correct: He drove out all those buying and selling there
reading.explain: The text says Jesus 'выгнал оттуда всех продающих и покупающих' (drove out all those who were selling and buying).

reading.ru: дом мой будет назван домом молитвы, а вы превратили его в разбойничье логово
reading.question: What did Jesus say the temple had been turned into?
reading.explain: Jesus said the house of prayer had been turned 'в разбойничье логово' (into a den of robbers).

reading.ru: Иисус сказал дереву, «Пусть же от тебя никогда больше не будет плодов». Инжир сразу же засох.
reading.question: What happened to the fig tree after Jesus cursed it?
options: It was cut down by the disciples
reading.explain: The text says 'Инжир сразу же засох' (the fig tree immediately withered).

reading.ru: если вы будете верить, не сомневаясь, то сможете сделать не только то, что было сделано с инжиром
reading.question: What did Jesus teach the disciples about faith after the fig tree withered?
options: Believing without doubting allows even greater things than what happened to the fig tree
Faith is unnecessary if you pray correctly
Only priests can perform such miracles
The fig tree incident could never be repeated
reading.correct: Believing without doubting allows even greater things than what happened to the fig tree
reading.explain: Jesus said if they believed without doubting, they could do 'не только то, что было сделано с инжиром' (not only what was done to the fig tree) but even more.

reading.question: How did the chief priests and elders answer Jesus' question about John's baptism?
options: They said they did not know
They said it was from heaven
They said it was from men
They refused to answer at all
reading.correct: They said they did not know
reading.explain: Unable to commit to either answer, they said '«Мы не знаем»' (We do not know).

reading.ru: «Не хочу», — ответил сын, но потом передумал и все же пошел.
reading.question: How did the first son respond in the parable of the two sons?
options: He initially refused but later changed his mind and went
He agreed at once and went immediately
He asked his father for help first
reading.correct: He initially refused but later changed his mind and went
reading.explain: The text says the son first said '«Не хочу»' (I will not) but 'потом передумал и все же пошел' (later changed his mind and went anyway).

reading.ru: Говорю вам истину, сборщики налогов и блудницы впереди вас идут в Царство Божие.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about tax collectors and prostitutes?
options: They are entering the kingdom of God ahead of the religious leaders
They would never be allowed into the kingdom of God
They were exempt from following the law
reading.correct: They are entering the kingdom of God ahead of the religious leaders
reading.explain: Jesus said 'сборщики налогов и блудницы впереди вас идут в Царство Божие' (tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you).

reading.ru: Они схватили его, выбросили из виноградника и убили.
reading.question: What did the tenant farmers do to the landowner's son in the parable?
options: They seized him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him
They welcomed him and gave him the harvest
They imprisoned him until the owner arrived
They sent him back with a message of respect
reading.correct: They seized him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him
reading.explain: The text says they 'схватили его, выбросили из виноградника и убили' (seized him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him).

reading.ru: Камень, который отвергли строители, стал краеугольным.
reading.question: What does Jesus say became the cornerstone?
options: The wine press dug by the landowner
reading.explain: Jesus quotes Scripture: 'Камень, который отвергли строители, стал краеугольным' (the stone the builders rejected became the cornerstone).
